operand_layout: +2 u16 count/flags (low14=count, bit14=phase marker, bit15 forwarded flag); +4 count records of {u16 role_selector,u16 tile_x,u16 tile_y,i16 action_id,i16 base_variant,i16 variant_delta}
state_reads: context source GUID; role lookup; selected role world coordinates for FFFF tile components; role+0x10 bit 0x02000000; record action operands
state_writes: initial phase clears source role bit 0x00080000 and cached action variants, initializes role+0x88 wait override, schedules each resolved role with all three action operands, sets selected-role dialog bit15, then sets operand bit14; ready phase clears operand high bits
flow_and_timing: bit14 clear schedules then yields; bit14 set queries each role and yields until every role is prepared/arrived; all ready advances 4+12*count and continues same call
error_or_quirk: missing role is skipped only in initial phase; wait-phase miss reaches the original role dereference; bit15 is forwarded to sub_42DAF0 then cleared with bit14 on completion; operand tails are read only at their original phase-specific danger points
